# Twilight of the Union: hand-written parts of the GDR focus tree (political, economy, military branches).
# common/national_focus/TOTU_DDR.txt is generated by tools/build_focus_tree.py from the focus editor (tree DDR);
# the editor can only describe these effects in words. <focus id>_effect runs at the end of the focus reward.
# Shared mechanics: the unification game (common/scripted_effects/TOTU_unity_*.txt), the Soviet bloc
# (common/scripted_effects/TOTU_bloc_effects.txt), the 18 March election (TOTU_DDR_effects.txt).
# Tooltips: localisation/*/totu_ddr_tree_l_*.yml, totu_ddr_politics_l_*.yml.

### political ###

### Political branch (branch_political.json). Unification API: common/scripted_effects/TOTU_unity_*.txt.

# Unification steps of focuses that stay available after Germany is united are wrapped in
# TOTU_DDR_pol_german_question_open (= TOTU_unity_open, common/scripted_triggers); the others check it in their available.

# The first focus of a government elected on 18 March: the election law (focus DDR_election_law) gives it a mandate.
TOTU_DDR_pol_election_law_bonus = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = TOTU_DDR_election_law }
		add_political_power = 50
	}
}

# The 'For Our Country' appeal has no one to address once the democrats govern.
TOTU_DDR_pol_drop_third_way = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = TOTU_DDR_third_way }
		remove_ideas = TOTU_DDR_third_way
	}
}

# The Stasi files laws (DDR_stasi_files_law, DDR_right_to_ones_file): the archives are complete if the citizens'
# committees kept them (focus DDR_citizens_committees or event totu_ddr.1 of 15 January).
TOTU_DDR_pol_files_bonus = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = TOTU_DDR_files_guarded
				has_country_flag = TOTU_DDR_stasi_files_saved
			}
		}
		add_stability = 0.05
	}
}

### Pre-election trunk ###

# The first focus tells the player what decides the 18 March election (TOTU_DDR_count_votes).
DDR_modrow_government_effect = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = DDR_pol_election_rules_tt
}

# February 1990: the Round Table lets the HVA dissolve itself; its agent files in the West are destroyed.
DDR_hva_self_dissolution_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = SOV }
		SOV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = TOTU_ddr_hva_dissolved } }
	}
}

# 20 February 1990: the new government elected under this law starts with a stronger mandate.
DDR_election_law_effect = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = DDR_election_law_tt
}

# 4 February 1990: the SED-PDS drops the "SED". The election renames it anyway (TOTU_DDR_count_votes).
DDR_party_of_democratic_socialism_effect = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = DDR_party_of_democratic_socialism_tt
	set_party_name = {
		ideology = communism
		name = DDR_pds_party
		long_name = DDR_pds_party_long
	}
}

# 30 January 1990: Gorbachev does not object to unification in principle.
DDR_moscow_visit_effect = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = DDR_pol_moscow_visit_tt
	set_country_flag = TOTU_DDR_moscow_blessing
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = SOV }
		SOV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = TOTU_ddr_moscow_talks } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { TOTU_DDR_pol_german_question_open = yes }
		TOTU_unity_progress_add_3 = yes
	}
}

# 1 February 1990: "For Germany, united fatherland", the GDR's own road to unity.
DDR_modrow_plan_effect = {
	set_country_flag = TOTU_DDR_modrow_plan
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = GER }
		GER = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = TOTU_ddr_modrow_plan } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { TOTU_DDR_pol_german_question_open = yes }
		TOTU_unity_ddr_pull_3 = yes
	}
}

		TOTU_unity_ger_pull_3 = yes
	}
}

	TOTU_DDR_pol_election_law_bonus = yes

		limit = { TOTU_DDR_pol_german_question_open = yes }
		TOTU_unity_progress_add_2 = yes
	}

		country_event = { id = totu_ddr_pol.1 days = 7 }
	}
}

# The Austrian deal is an offer, and Moscow answers: the USSR gets the exit protocol event
# (totu_ddr_pol.3); its answer reaches the GDR in totu_ddr_pol.4, which calls TOTU_bloc_leave only if the USSR signs.
DDR_austrian_option_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = TOTU_left_warsaw_pact } }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = SOV }
			custom_effect_tooltip = DDR_pol_austrian_offer_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				SOV = { country_event = { id = totu_ddr_pol.3 days = 1 } }
			}
		}
		else = {
			TOTU_bloc_leave = yes
		}
	}
}

# Neutrality like Austria's in 1955: the Soviet troops go home (the military branch's DDR_mil_wgf_withdrawal does the
# same; whichever comes first removes the Western Group of Forces).
DDR_permanent_neutrality_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_idea = TOTU_DDR_western_group
				has_idea = TOTU_DDR_mil_brotherhood_in_arms
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = TOTU_DDR_western_group }
			remove_ideas = TOTU_DDR_western_group
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = TOTU_DDR_mil_brotherhood_in_arms }
			remove_ideas = TOTU_DDR_mil_brotherhood_in_arms
		}
		add_timed_idea = {
			idea = TOTU_DDR_mil_wgf_departure
			days = 730
		}
	}
}

# Locked hard-line path: only when the Soviet hard-liners are in power (Foros or the state of emergency).
DDR_lean_on_moscow_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_autonomy_state = autonomy_totu_socialist_commonwealth }
		add_autonomy_ratio = {
			value = -0.15
			localization = DDR_pol_autonomy_moscow
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = SOV }
		SOV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = TOTU_ddr_hardline_ally } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { TOTU_DDR_pol_german_question_open = yes }
		TOTU_unity_progress_sub_10 = yes
		TOTU_unity_freeze_180 = yes
	}
}

### Long term: a GDR that is still there at the end of 1990 ###

# 19-21 November 1990, the CSCE summit in Paris: better trade with the neighbours and the Western powers.
DDR_charter_of_paris_effect = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				tag = GER
				tag = FRA
				tag = ENG
				tag = USA
				tag = POL
				tag = CZE
			}
		}
		add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = TOTU_ddr_charter_of_paris }
	}
}

# A new mandate: the spirits of the spring coalitions go with it.
DDR_snap_election_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = TOTU_DDR_grand_coalition }
		remove_ideas = TOTU_DDR_grand_coalition
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = TOTU_DDR_maximilian_affair }
		remove_ideas = TOTU_DDR_maximilian_affair
	}
}

### economy ###

# Who governs after 18 March: TOTU_DDR_eco_democrats_govern / TOTU_DDR_eco_pds_governs (hand triggers below).
# Unification: the API of common/scripted_effects/TOTU_unity_api.txt. Every call is wrapped in TOTU_unity_open, so the
# focus tooltips stop promising unity points once the German question is closed (unified, referendum called, talks
# ended, or one of the two states gone).
# No state ids: buildings go to random owned and controlled states outside the capital (East Berlin), inland where
# the real plant is inland.

### Money ###

# 18 May / 1 July 1990: the State Treaty. The mark ends the exodus ("if the D-Mark comes, we stay") and every
# subsidy; the factories take the shock (short time instead, if unemployment insurance is already in place).
# The focus needs Bonn's word (DDR_eco_currency_union_available); Bonn's own decisions (the D-Mark promise +8, the
# treaty +15) count their part, so the GDR's side adds a flat 5 whatever the order. An SPD government bargains over
# the rates (1:1 for wages was its demand), so part of its step counts as the GDR's.
DDR_eco_currency_union_effect = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = DDR_eco_currency_union_tt
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = TOTU_DDR_open_border }
		remove_ideas = TOTU_DDR_open_border
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = TOTU_DDR_cheap_bread }
		remove_ideas = TOTU_DDR_cheap_bread
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = TOTU_DDR_price_reform }
		remove_ideas = TOTU_DDR_price_reform
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = DDR_eco_unemployment_insurance }
		add_ideas = TOTU_DDR_short_time_work
	}
	else = {
		add_ideas = TOTU_DDR_dmark_shock
	}
	set_country_flag = TOTU_DDR_currency_union
	if = {
		limit = { TOTU_unity_open = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = TOTU_DDR_government_spd }
			TOTU_unity_ger_pull_3 = yes
			TOTU_unity_ddr_pull_2 = yes
		}
		else = {
			TOTU_unity_ger_pull_5 = yes
		}
	}
}

# The SPD's own step: the Round Table's Social Charter (March 1990) made a condition of the treaty. Balanced pull.
DDR_eco_social_charter_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { TOTU_unity_open = yes }
		TOTU_unity_ddr_pull_3 = yes
		TOTU_unity_ger_pull_3 = yes
	}
}

# The PDS way: Christa Luft's convertibility, done in one year on KoKo's reserves. A mark worth something keeps
# most people at home, but not the specialists; subsidised prices cannot survive a real exchange rate.
DDR_eco_convertible_mark_effect = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = DDR_eco_convertible_mark_tt
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = TOTU_DDR_open_border }
		swap_ideas = { remove_idea = TOTU_DDR_open_border add_idea = TOTU_DDR_brain_drain }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = TOTU_DDR_cheap_bread }
		remove_ideas = TOTU_DDR_cheap_bread
		add_stability = -0.05
	}
	set_country_flag = TOTU_DDR_convertible_mark
	if = {
		limit = { TOTU_unity_open = yes }
		TOTU_unity_progress_sub_5 = yes
	}
}

# The democrats' end of the KoKo line: Schalck's accounts are traced and go into the budget.
DDR_eco_koko_accounts_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = GER }
		GER = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = TOTU_ddr_eco_koko_accounts } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { TOTU_unity_open = yes }
		TOTU_unity_ger_pull_2 = yes
	}
}

# 16 May 1990: 115 billion DM for the GDR budget until 1994. Roads and telephone lines across the East, not in
# East Berlin (already near the maximum): two random states that can still take infrastructure.
DDR_eco_unity_fund_effect = {
	every_owned_state = {
		limit = {
			is_capital = no
			is_controlled_by = ROOT
			infrastructure < 5
		}
		random_select_amount = 2
		add_building_construction = {
			type = infrastructure
			level = 1
			instant_build = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { TOTU_unity_open = yes }
		TOTU_unity_ger_pull_5 = yes
	}
}

# The end of the democratic path: the shock is over.
DDR_eco_social_market_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = TOTU_DDR_dmark_shock }
		remove_ideas = TOTU_DDR_dmark_shock
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = TOTU_DDR_short_time_work }
		remove_ideas = TOTU_DDR_short_time_work
	}
	if = {
		limit = { TOTU_unity_open = yes }
		TOTU_unity_progress_add_5 = yes
	}
}

# The end of the PDS path: a GDR that pays its way is an argument for unity on its own terms.
DDR_eco_socialist_market_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = TOTU_DDR_brain_drain }
		remove_ideas = TOTU_DDR_brain_drain
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = TOTU_DDR_price_reform }
		remove_ideas = TOTU_DDR_price_reform
	}

		limit = { TOTU_unity_open = yes }
		TOTU_unity_ddr_pull_5 = yes
	}
}

### Property ###

# 17 June 1990: the Treuhand law, privatisation first. A little new industry, but the closures come first.
DDR_eco_privatisation_law_effect = {
	random_owned_controlled_state = {
		limit = { is_capital = no }
		add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
		add_building_construction = {
			type = industrial_complex
			level = 1
			instant_build = yes
		}
	}
	add_timed_idea = { idea = TOTU_DDR_wave_of_closures days = 180 }
	set_country_flag = TOTU_DDR_privatisation
	if = {
		limit = { TOTU_unity_open = yes }
		TOTU_unity_ger_pull_3 = yes
	}
}

# Wolfgang Ullmann's share certificates: the people's property stays with the people, in the GDR.
DDR_eco_share_certificates_effect = {
	set_country_flag = TOTU_DDR_people_shares
	if = {
		limit = { TOTU_unity_open = yes }
		TOTU_unity_ddr_pull_3 = yes
	}
}

# AFG of the GDR (1 July 1990), Kurzarbeit Null: the shock is cushioned, at a price.
DDR_eco_unemployment_insurance_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = TOTU_DDR_dmark_shock }
		swap_ideas = { remove_idea = TOTU_DDR_dmark_shock add_idea = TOTU_DDR_short_time_work }
	}
}

# Democrats: the joint declaration of 15 June 1990 ("restitution before compensation", the 1945-49 land reform
# stays). PDS: the Modrow law of 7 March 1990 extended, the houses stay with their occupants.
DDR_eco_property_question_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { TOTU_DDR_eco_democrats_govern = yes }
		custom_effect_tooltip = DDR_eco_property_restitution_tt
		add_timed_idea = { idea = TOTU_DDR_restitution_claims days = 365 }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = GER }
			GER = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = TOTU_ddr_eco_property_deal } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { TOTU_unity_open = yes }
			TOTU_unity_progress_add_3 = yes
		}
	}
	else = {
		custom_effect_tooltip = DDR_eco_property_tenants_tt
		add_stability = 0.05
		add_popularity = { ideology = communism popularity = 0.03 }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = GER }
			GER = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = TOTU_ddr_eco_property_dispute } }
		}
	}
}

# 29 June 1990: the LPG adaptation law.
DDR_eco_lpg_reform_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { TOTU_DDR_eco_democrats_govern = yes }
		custom_effect_tooltip = DDR_eco_lpg_private_tt
		add_popularity = { ideology = democratic popularity = 0.03 }
	}
	else = {
		custom_effect_tooltip = DDR_eco_lpg_coop_tt
		add_popularity = { ideology = communism popularity = 0.03 }
	}
}

### military ###

# Twilight of the Union, GDR focus tree, military branch (keys f_ddr_mil_*): the NVA in 1990.
# Army spirit chain: TOTU_DDR_army_at_a_loss -> soldiers_councils | barracks_discipline (Beelitz choice)
# -> mil_military_reform (DDR_mil_military_reform) -> mil_citizens_in_uniform (DDR_mil_new_oath, which needs the reform).
# Soviet garrison: TOTU_DDR_western_group -> mil_stationing_treaty (PDS) or mil_brotherhood_in_arms (hidden hard-line
# path, undone by DDR_mil_back_to_barracks); DDR_mil_wgf_withdrawal removes any of them and gives mil_wgf_departure.
# Leaving the Warsaw Pact itself (TOTU_bloc_leave) is the political branch's; the military only leaves the Unified
# Command (DDR_mil_leave_unified_command, flag TOTU_DDR_mil_left_unified_command).

# Combat Groups of the Working Class: their rifles go to the depots.
DDR_mil_kampfgruppen_effect = {
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
		type = infantry_equipment
		amount = 3000
		producer = DDR
	}
}

# The reform replaces whichever spirit the Beelitz choice left.
DDR_mil_military_reform_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = TOTU_DDR_mil_soldiers_councils }
		swap_ideas = {
			remove_idea = TOTU_DDR_mil_soldiers_councils
			add_idea = TOTU_DDR_mil_military_reform
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = TOTU_DDR_mil_barracks_discipline }
		swap_ideas = {
			remove_idea = TOTU_DDR_mil_barracks_discipline
			add_idea = TOTU_DDR_mil_military_reform
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = TOTU_DDR_mil_citizens_in_uniform }
		army_experience = 10
	}
	else = {
		add_ideas = TOTU_DDR_mil_military_reform
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = TOTU_DDR_army_at_a_loss }
		remove_ideas = TOTU_DDR_army_at_a_loss
	}
}

# 20 July 1990: the new oath ends the transition; the reform spirit becomes Citizens in Uniform.
DDR_mil_new_oath_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = TOTU_DDR_mil_military_reform }
		swap_ideas = {
			remove_idea = TOTU_DDR_mil_military_reform
			add_idea = TOTU_DDR_mil_citizens_in_uniform
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = TOTU_DDR_mil_soldiers_councils }
		swap_ideas = {
			remove_idea = TOTU_DDR_mil_soldiers_councils
			add_idea = TOTU_DDR_mil_citizens_in_uniform
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = TOTU_DDR_mil_barracks_discipline }
		swap_ideas = {
			remove_idea = TOTU_DDR_mil_barracks_discipline
			add_idea = TOTU_DDR_mil_citizens_in_uniform
		}
	}
	else = {
		add_ideas = TOTU_DDR_mil_citizens_in_uniform
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = TOTU_DDR_army_at_a_loss }
		remove_ideas = TOTU_DDR_army_at_a_loss
	}
}

# Winter 1989/90: soldiers fill the jobs of those who left.
DDR_mil_soldiers_in_factories_effect = {
	add_timed_idea = {
		idea = TOTU_DDR_mil_soldiers_in_factories
		days = 180
	}
}

		limit = { TOTU_unity_active = yes }
		TOTU_unity_progress_add_3 = yes
	}
}

	}

	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = SOV }
		SOV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = TOTU_ddr_mil_wgf_bill } }
	}
}

# CFE talks in Vienna: the West notices a GDR delegation with a voice of its own.
DDR_mil_vienna_talks_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = GER }
		GER = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = TOTU_ddr_mil_vienna_talks } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = USA }
		USA = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = TOTU_ddr_mil_vienna_talks } }
	}
}

# The Soviet troops leave (consent is checked in DDR_mil_wgf_withdrawal_available). The GDR stays in the Pact.
# Bonn pays (historically 12 billion DM + 3 billion credit) under the Alliance, or under the SPD once it has accepted
# the Genscher formula (that focus asks Bonn to pay for the withdrawal).
DDR_mil_wgf_withdrawal_effect = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = DDR_mil_wgf_withdrawal_tt
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = TOTU_DDR_western_group }
		remove_ideas = TOTU_DDR_western_group
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = TOTU_DDR_mil_stationing_treaty }
		remove_ideas = TOTU_DDR_mil_stationing_treaty
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = TOTU_DDR_mil_brotherhood_in_arms }
		remove_ideas = TOTU_DDR_mil_brotherhood_in_arms
	}
	clr_country_flag = TOTU_DDR_mil_treaty_suspended
	add_timed_idea = {
		idea = TOTU_DDR_mil_wgf_departure
		days = 730
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_autonomy_state = autonomy_totu_socialist_commonwealth }
		add_autonomy_ratio = {
			value = 0.1
			localization = DDR_mil_wgf_withdrawal_autonomy
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = GER
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = TOTU_DDR_government_alliance
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = TOTU_DDR_government_spd
					has_completed_focus = DDR_genscher_formula
				}
			}
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = DDR_mil_wgf_bonn_pays_tt
		if = {
			limit = { TOTU_unity_active = yes }
			TOTU_unity_ger_pull_5 = yes
		}
	}
	else = {
		add_political_power = -50
	}
}

# The military half of leaving the bloc, by the rules: the NVA leaves the Unified Armed Forces, the GDR stays in the
# Pact. The political branch (DDR_leave_warsaw_pact, DDR_austrian_option) does TOTU_bloc_leave and may read the flag
# TOTU_DDR_mil_left_unified_command (set by the focus itself).
DDR_mil_leave_unified_command_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = SOV }
		SOV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = TOTU_ddr_mil_unified_command } }
	}
}

# PDS: the Soviet troops stay under a renegotiated (paid) stationing agreement. The garrison spirit itself is swapped by
# the editor effect (available only while TOTU_DDR_western_group is in force).
DDR_mil_stationing_treaty_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = SOV }
		SOV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = TOTU_ddr_mil_stationing_treaty } }
	}
}

# Hidden hard-line path: the NVA stands with the hard-liners. The garrison spirit (plain or by treaty) becomes
# Brotherhood in Arms until DDR_mil_back_to_barracks (the flag remembers a suspended stationing treaty).
DDR_mil_nva_on_alert_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = TOTU_DDR_mil_stationing_treaty }
		set_country_flag = TOTU_DDR_mil_treaty_suspended
		swap_ideas = {
			remove_idea = TOTU_DDR_mil_stationing_treaty
			add_idea = TOTU_DDR_mil_brotherhood_in_arms
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = TOTU_DDR_western_group }
		swap_ideas = {
			remove_idea = TOTU_DDR_western_group
			add_idea = TOTU_DDR_mil_brotherhood_in_arms
		}
	}
	else = {
		add_ideas = TOTU_DDR_mil_brotherhood_in_arms
	}
	if = {
		limit = { TOTU_unity_active = yes }
		TOTU_unity_progress_sub_10 = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = GER }
		GER = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = TOTU_ddr_mil_on_alert } }
	}
}

# The way back from the hard-line path: Brotherhood in Arms becomes the garrison spirit it replaced.
DDR_mil_back_to_barracks_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = TOTU_DDR_mil_brotherhood_in_arms }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = TOTU_DDR_mil_treaty_suspended }
			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = TOTU_DDR_mil_brotherhood_in_arms
				add_idea = TOTU_DDR_mil_stationing_treaty
			}
		}
		else = {
			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = TOTU_DDR_mil_brotherhood_in_arms
				add_idea = TOTU_DDR_western_group
			}
		}
	}
	clr_country_flag = TOTU_DDR_mil_treaty_suspended
}
